Estimate CFU from a dilution series

estimate_cfu.Rd

Applies either find_mle() (the default) or find_poisson_cutoff() to each group of a data frame of colony counts and converts the result to CFU/ml.

Usage

estimate_cfu(
  data,
  count = count,
  dilution = dilution,
  group = NULL,
  method = c("mle", "poisson"),
  N = NULL,
  sampling_vol = 0.1
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per counted spot or plate. Input data is expected to have a header row, e.g. as read by utils::read.csv() or readr::read_csv().

count, dilution

<tidy-select> The single column holding colony counts and the single column holding dilution factors, e.g. count = n_colonies. Strings such as "n_colonies" also work. Default to columns named count and dilution. Dilutions must be numeric (e.g. 1e-6).

group

<tidy-select> Columns to group by. Any combination of tidyselect expressions can be used, e.g. c(strain, rep), starts_with("treat"), where(is.character) or all_of(vars). Leave as NULL for no grouping. Strings such as "strain" also work.

method

Estimator to use: "mle" for find_mle() (default) or "poisson" for find_poisson_cutoff().

N

Threshold passed to the chosen estimator. For "mle", the maximum number of countable colonies (see find_mle()); defaults to 5000, as recommended for 100 mm petri dishes. For "poisson", counts at or above N are excluded (see find_poisson_cutoff()); defaults to 300, also as recommended for 100 mm petri dishes.

sampling_vol

Volume plated or spotted, in milliliters (ml), used to convert absolute CFU to CFU/ml. Either a single positive number applied to all rows (e.g. 0.002 for a 2 ul spot), or the name of a column holding the volume for each row (e.g. vol_plated_ml). Defaults to 0.1 (100 ul). The volume must be constant within each group.

Value

A data frame with one row per group: the grouping columns, estimator (the estimator used), CFU_ml (CFU/ml) and CFU_ml_stderr (its standard error, also per ml).

Details

Absolute CFU in the amount plated or spotted is divided by sampling_vol, which is always in milliliters, so CFU_ml is in CFU/ml. The default of 0.1 (100 ul) is the usual volume plated on a 100 mm petri dish (use 0.002 for a 2 ul spot). The same volume must be used for all dilutions.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "cfu_example.tsv", package = "CFUestimatoR")
cfu <- read.delim(path)

# Plate counts on 100 mm dishes; replicates are pooled within each group
estimate_cfu(
  cfu,
  count = colony_count,
  group = c(measurement, time_hours, growth_media, sample_or_strain),
  N = 5000,
  sampling_vol = vol_plated_ml
)
#>               measurement time_hours growth_media sample_or_strain    estimator
#> 1 SGT calibration plating         48      PPY+Str          control ML_estimator
#> 2          direct plating         48          PPY               E1 ML_estimator
#> 3          direct plating         48          PPY               E2 ML_estimator
#> 4          direct plating         48      PPY+Str               E1 ML_estimator
#> 5          direct plating         48      PPY+Str               E2 ML_estimator
#> 6  starting-density check          0          PPY            1977A ML_estimator
#> 7  starting-density check          0      PPY+Str            1977E ML_estimator
#>       CFU_ml CFU_ml_stderr
#> 1 2117968546     110561892
#> 2 1469416498      82274187
#> 3 2154889790      99937499
#> 4  360327325      40540075
#> 5  589537227      51906132
#> 6 3179163302     121933373
#> 7 3891949271     135366618

# Poisson cutoff estimator, grouping by any tidyselect expression
estimate_cfu(
  cfu,
  count = colony_count,
  group = c(sample_or_strain, growth_media),
  method = "poisson",
  N = 500,
  sampling_vol = vol_plated_ml
)
#>   sample_or_strain growth_media      estimator     CFU_ml CFU_ml_stderr
#> 1            1977A          PPY poisson_cutoff 3090909091     118530953
#> 2            1977E      PPY+Str poisson_cutoff 3759090909     130716399
#> 3               E1          PPY poisson_cutoff 1450000000      81184414
#> 4               E1      PPY+Str poisson_cutoff  359090909      40400884
#> 5               E2          PPY poisson_cutoff 2113636364      98017539
#> 6               E2      PPY+Str poisson_cutoff  586363636      51626440
#> 7          control      PPY+Str poisson_cutoff 2085227273     108847978
